packages.title: Amnezia6
packages.status_text: 1.3.0 adds continuous camera scanning and official animated Amnezia multipart QR assembly with N/M progress and explicit review before saving. On7.1.2 the actual camera delivered frames; lifecycle stop/restart and four-part CMSampleBuffer replay into the real app passed. Profiles were preserved. Optical scanning of a physical animated sender screen and iOS4–6 camera execution remain untested. Prior engine relay test passed; direct endpoint timeout remains unlocalised.

packages.title: Performance Overlay
packages.tagline: FPS / CPU / RAM / GPU HUD for iOS 4.3–9
packages.status_text: 0.1.10 native A7 page accounting and driver snapshots verified. Controlled Settings A/B: HUD ON28–33% AGX snapshot/~1 redraw per second; OFF0% with no redraws. RAM531MiB includes79MiB inactive,444MiB free, no pageout growth. GPU value is not calibrated peak GPU power. Visible rotation remains unverified.

packages.title: Power Logger
packages.tagline: Battery and per-process CPU logger for iOS 6–7
packages.status_text: iOS 7.1.2 verified: 1.1.1 installs, launchd runs the arm64 daemon, and status.json reports 1.1.1 with recording off. Native sampling read 85 processes / 84 CPU deltas and corrected 16 KiB task versus 4 KiB kernel page accounting.

packages.title: Legacy Game FPS
packages.tagline: Per-game frame pacing for exact legacy builds
packages.status_text: 0.2.2 installs on 7.1.2 and its arm64 Settings bundle loads. None of the four supported games is installed on the test device, so the iOS 7 hook and gameplay timing remain unverified.

packages.title: Veteris Native iPad
packages.tagline: Native iPad layout and suspension fix for Veteris 4
packages.status_text: iOS 6 layout and suspension behavior verified. iOS 7 layout policy and metadata self-tests pass; full Veteris 4 UI/background behavior is untested. The iOS 6 SGX disk-cache workaround is deliberately skipped on iOS 7.

packages.title: LocalSend (IPA Installer)
packages.status_text: This package installs the IPA; it is not the app itself. Package, maintainer-script, IPA and armv7 iOS 7 runtime audits pass, but install, launch, photo selection and transfer were not run: the test iPad lacks ai.akemi.appinst / AppSync Unified and cydia.akemi.ai was unreachable. Requires Karen's official source.

packages.title: Blastron Revival
packages.tagline: Compatibility and engine fixes for Blastron
packages.status_text: Built and tested against Blastron on iOS 6 only; the package keeps firmware < 7.0. It contains no original game assets.

packages.title: Legacy Timezone Update
packages.status_text: 2026e-2 installed, removed, reinstalled and rebooted on iPad mini2/7.1.2. All600 managed files verify; native armv7 and arm64 NSTimeZone, libc and NSDateFormatter match155 IANA date/region cases each. Moscow isUTC+3 with historical offsets preserved. Removal restores original data. No background service.

packages.title: Legacy Device Access
packages.status_text: iOS 7.1.2 verified: 1.1.0 performed status, lock and unlock and refused a simulated passcode. One-shot root CLI; no daemon or boot hook. iOS 4.3.3 and 6.1.3 adapters remain.

packages.title: Legacy C++ Runtime (iOS 4)
packages.status_text: Installs the missing shared C++ runtime on iOS 4.3. iOS 5 and later already provide their own runtime, so installation is refused there. This is intentionally not an iOS 7 replacement.
packages.source: Corresponding source archive with build scripts and licenses

packages.title: Legacy 1080p60 Timing Fix
packages.tagline: Guarded H.264 decode-hint fix for iPad 2 / iOS 4.3.3
packages.status_text: Exact iPad 2 / 8J2 mediaserverd timing workaround. It is not applied to iOS 7: that decoder path has not demonstrated the same regression. Other media and timestamps are preserved.
packages.source: Corresponding source archive with build scripts and licenses

packages.title: LocalSend Photos Without Location (iOS 4)
packages.tagline: LocalSend-specific old Photos permission gate adapter
packages.status_text: Exact iOS 4.3.3 / LocalSend gate adapter; no GPS requests or global location permission change. iOS 6/7 use their native photo permissions and must not receive this hook.
packages.source: Corresponding source archive with build scripts and licenses
